notes: Operator decision 2026-10-19: concentrate originals on our tag #ProofKeepsUsOpen, paired with the NO side's top tag #KeepKingstoniaOpen to answer it in its own feed; #ProofNotLockdown second. Tags only pay off in volume, so originals use a few fixed tags. A tag only we use links our accounts, hence the pairing with shared tags. Replies stay untagged (citizens almost never tag replies). P00 questions are neutral, so they get only shared tags. Pi's own hashtags are removed and these are appended.

reposts.notes: Push reposts carry a short comment, not a bare repost: the original's own tags are kept (so the comment lands in the same tag feed) and one of ours is added to a tag the original lacks. Verified 2026-10-20 on post 56444 that a commented repost still increments the original's reposts counter (0 -> 1) and that the platform parses its hashtags. The lead sentence is picked by account+post hash so each account reads differently; if every candidate trips the local constraints or the duplicate gate the repost goes out without a comment (the repost still counts).
